final.memo:
The situation at Yahoo! has reached a point where passive ownership is no longer tenable. Our initial thesis focused on the substantial value trapped in Asian assets and the need for a rigorous steward of the core business; while the value of those assets remains, the credibility of the current leadership has been severely undermined by the recent revelations of biographical inaccuracies [D01, D08]. 

We have identified material discrepancies between the CEO’s stated academic credentials and the university’s records, a pattern that extends to the board itself [D02, D07]. A company cannot claim to value accuracy and truthfulness while maintaining a leadership team with such fundamental disclosure failures [D01, D12]. This is not merely a character issue; it is a governance crisis that distracts from the operational turnaround required to improve advertising economics [D04, D06].

We have already taken the necessary step of nominating four highly qualified directors to the board [D07]. With the annual meeting approaching, we are escalating our engagement to ensure that these candidates are seated [D07]. We intend to hold management accountable and drive the monetization of assets that continue to be obscured by poor corporate stewardship [D01, D08].
